text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? We're on the final stretch, where 
it should be getting tough by now, and 
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My legs... they're moving! With this, I 
can...! HAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… I did it…… I did it, I did it, 
hooray!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Me, a Kikuka Sho Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wonder what happened? I really 
thought 3,000 meters might be impossible 
for me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Congratulations... Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen. Thanks. Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It kind of surprised me, too. I never 
thought I could do this well over 3,000 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You've done quite a lot of training, 
haven't you? Over the course of the 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And she's doing it in a different way than 
before. Her lower body movements were 
clearly distinct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
During the summer... A different approach 
from before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I see. She's been living outdoors the 
whole time, running up and down steep 
slopes, so maybe that's...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This defeat... For today, at least... I 
shall accept it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the ultimate goal is strictly the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). I am still on the way. 
I'm still in the middle of it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu, uuuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You need not feel responsible. This is 
entirely my own failing. A weakness in my 
resolve. A lack of strength."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to win this one so badly... 
*sob*, *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen... McQueen cares this deeply 
about winning...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I won, sure. And of course I gave it my 
all! But...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Feelings strong enough to bring tears 
naturally to my eyes... Did I have them? 
Truly... ?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the winner's interview was 
held—

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is the Passion Sports 
Newspaper! Mejiro Palmer-san, that was a 
truly magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Who is the first person you'd like to 
express your current gratitude to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right... The first thing I 
want to tell them is...

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
It's Dad, of course, right? Yes, more than 
anyone, it's Dad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...? Well, that's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Dad!? Dad, you came for today's 
interview!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My dad. He's a writer for newspapers and 
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy~ To think she'd come in person to 
interview her own daughter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. I see, so you're the 
one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... my daughter, she doesn't 
really talk about you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer's Father
text_block_list.text:
She's usually the kind of girl who speaks 
pretty honestly about anything. Which 
makes this awfully suspicious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer's Father
text_block_list.text:
So... honestly speaking, what do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, knock it off! You sound like 
some gossip reporter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the lively, harmonious atmosphere 
and playful banter, the interview turned 
out to be a great success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm happy we won today, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, maybe I'm... just a little 
different from the other Mejiro girls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... like passion for the race, or the 
strength to keep aiming higher?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan ran in all three Classic Triple Crown 
races, and she saw every single one 
through with a sense of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen was really emotionally invested in 
today's race, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, all I was thinking was... 'Let's 
just be myself and have fun running.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you ask whether I was able to run with 
as much resolve and heart as those two, I 
don't think I quite measured up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I love running. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Where is it... that I truly belong to run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding! I just got to 
thinking for a second. Like, 'where is my 
place!?' or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, forget it, forget it! Oh yeah, wanna 
try some of that spicy pudding in the 
fridge? It's strangely addictive, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dodging the question, Mejiro Palmer headed 
for the fridge. It seemed her mind wasn't 
fully made up yet.
